title: ConnectionError While Signing In (oauth.callback)
body:
## Actual

Once a few hundred calls have gone through, the connections fail until a restart. It shows up under load; the connection count in the monitor keeps climbing and never drops.

## Expected

Expected signing in to finish without errors.

## Frequency

Happens only on the first run after login.

## Steps

Steps to reproduce:
* Start by signing in.
* Put the app under load with the stress script for five minutes.
* Wait for the failure and read the log.

## Environment

Lattice 3.3.0, Windows 11 24H2, server ca-central-1.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:50 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:122 in on_login
lattice/auth/flow.py:55 in start

ConnectionError: connection reset by peer (host=ca-central-1)
